Cooking Companions is OUT on [url="https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/"]Nintendo Switch[/url]/[url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262"]PS4/PS5[/url]/[url="https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010"]Xbox![/url] With the help of Serenity Forge,  all owners of Cooking Companions on Steam will be receiving this gigantic update for free as our way of saying "thank you" for the incredible years of support. In addition: [b]both [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263230/Cooking_Companions/"]Cooking Companions[/url][b] and the sequel, [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/"]Dread Weight[/url][b], are ON SALE![/b][/p][p][/p][p]在塔特拉山脈的森林深處，物資日益匱乏，洪水漸漸上升。你需要保持大家的士氣。你能夠討得關鍵人物的歡心嗎？還是終將淪為待宰羔羊呢？[/p][p][/p][p]タトラ山脈の奥深く山小屋に迷い込んだ若者たち。食料は底を尽き、洪水で水かさが増していく。みんなを励ませるかどうかは自分次第。機嫌を取る相手を間違えると、まな板の上で悲惨な運命が待っているかも？[/p][p][/p][p]타트라 산맥에 위치한 어느 깊은 숲속. 식량은 점점 바닥을 보이고, 홍수로 인해 불어난 물은 여러분을 위협해 오고 있습니다. 그 누구도 기운을 잃지 않도록 한 사람, 한 사람 신중하게 요리하세요. 자칫하다가는 여러분이 도마 위에 오르게 될지도 모르니까요.[/p][p][/p][p]在塔特拉山脉的森林深处，物资日益匮乏，洪水水位日渐上涨。你需要保持大家的士气。你能够讨得关键人物的欢心吗？还是终将沦为待宰羔羊呢？[/p][p][/p][p]En lo profundo de los bosques de los Montes Tatras, los suministros escasean y las aguas de las inundaciones aumentan. Depende de ti mantener el ánimo en alto. ¿Conseguirás convencer a la persona adecuada o acabarás en la guillotina?[/p][p][/p][p]Nas profundezas da floresta das Montanhas Tatra, os mantimentos diminuem e as águas da enchente sobem. Cabe a você manter o moral lá em cima. Você vai cair nas graças da pessoa certa? Ou vai acabar na tábua de corte?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/1659643e-3419-4faa-92f8-d569991d7c27/Cooking+Companions+PS5.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3]What's New?[/h3][p]-15 new, fully animated, cutscenes -Some improvements to the gameplay (and rewards!) [/p][p]-Typos, glitches, grammatical errors are FIXED! [/p][p]-Fully translated into Spanish, Chinese (both traditional and simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese [/p][p]-A few secrets to discover![/p][p][/p][h3]Grab it on consoles![/h3][p]If you want to support the game coming to consoles: please grab the game using the links below. [url="https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/"]Nintendo Switch[/url] [url="https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262"]PS4/PS5[/url] [url="https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010"]Xbox[/url] [url="https://store.serenityforge.com/products/cooking-companions-premium-edition"]Special physical edition for PS5[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p]This wouldn't have been possible without all of you: THANKS FOR PLAYING and ENJOY! [/p][p][/p][p]-Deer Dream Studios[/p]

notes.title: Cooking Companions HUGE Console Release Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=StjpXRmZL5I;full][/previewyoutube]
Cooking Companions is OUT on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/cooking-companions-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]/[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10013262]PS4/PS5[/url]/[url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/cooking-companions/9NNCF0RKXSTJ/0010]Xbox![/url] With the help of Serenity Forge, all owners of Cooking Companions Steam will be receiving this gigantic update for free as our way of saying "thank you" for the incredible years of support. [url=https://store.serenityforge.com/products/cooking-companions-premium-edition][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/1659643e-3419-4faa-92f8-d569991d7c27/Cooking+Companions+PS5.png[/img][/url]

[h3]What's New?[/h3]
-15 new, fully animated, cutscenes
-Some improvements to the gameplay (and rewards!)
-Typos, glitches, grammatical errors are FIXED!
-Fully translated into Spanish, Chinese (both traditional and simplified), Japanese, Korean, and Brazilian Portuguese
-A few secrets to discover!

[h3]Wishlist and Preorder![/h3]

If you want to support the game coming to consoles: please wishlist (or preorder) the game using the links below.

notes.title: New Demo at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=n6rm3FUJJdw;full][/previewyoutube]
IT'S HERE! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]The Cooking Companions sequel, Dread Weight, has a new demo LIVE, at Steam Next Fest![/url] Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399060/Dread_Weight/]wishlist the game on Steam:[/url] every one helps us out!

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/632240155e019f468cb3004a/0c9a9dde-b708-4ca2-9071-6a220df9dac7/Nyaaati+Gisela+Cosplay+Dread+Weight.jpg?format=750w[/img]
[i]Cosplayer: Nyaaati[/i]
[h2]The Demo[/h2]
Trapped in a crumbling mansion, you need to scavenge for items to outsmart and outlive an ancient witch hunting you down. If you've played the original Dread Weight demo, get ready: the new version has MORE story, MORE horror and cool unlockables to discover!

[list]
